common.usernameHint: 3–50 characters: letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore, @

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.languageLoad: The language could not be loaded.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to access your documents.

setup.title: Set up AIDocuments
setup.subtitle: Start by creating the administrator account. You can add more users in the settings afterwards.

features.import: PDFs from your mailbox and import folder
features.search: Full-text search right into the document

dropzone.title: Drop PDFs here
dropzone.hint: You can drop several files at once. They are stored, analyzed and tagged.

upload.onlyPdf: Only PDF files can be added.
upload.rejected_one: {{count, number}} file is not a valid PDF
upload.rejected_other: {{count, number}} files are not valid PDFs
upload.noneValid: None of the files is a valid PDF.

aiNotice.text: The AI has not been set up yet. New documents can be searched by their text, but they are not summarized or tagged.

progress.inProgressHint: Waiting for AI analysis or currently being analyzed
progress.finishHint: Expected to finish: {{time}} – estimated from the pace of the most recently processed documents

filters.title: Filters
filters.hint: Once documents have been analyzed, document types, tags and senders will appear here as filters.

empty.libraryHint: Simply drag PDF files into this window or use “Upload”.
empty.libraryHintAdmin: Simply drag PDF files into this window or use “Upload”. In the settings you can set up a mailbox or an import folder from which new PDFs are imported automatically.
empty.noResultsSearch: No document matches this search. The search also finds parts of words – try a shorter term or fewer words.
empty.noResultsFilters: No document matches the selected filters.

document.reprocessHint: Read the PDF again and have the AI analyze it
document.reprocessStarted: The document is being analyzed again.
document.processingNotice: The document is being processed. The summary and tags will appear here as soon as the analysis is finished.
document.textOnlyNotice: Indexed without AI: the document can be searched by its text, but it has no summary and no automatic tags.

tags.inputHint: Confirm with Enter or a comma. Suggestions are tags that are already in use.

document.noText: There is no text for this document – it is probably a scan without a text layer. With the AI set up and text recognition enabled, the content is transcribed during analysis.

delete.title: Delete document?
delete.text: “{{title}}” will be deleted together with its PDF file, full text and tags. This cannot be undone.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.navHint: IMAP servers from which PDF attachments are imported
mailboxes.intro: PDF attachments are imported automatically from these IMAP mailboxes. The mailboxes are only read – emails stay unchanged and unread.
mailboxes.emptyText: Enter the credentials of an IMAP mailbox – for example the mailbox your scanner sends documents to.
mailboxes.firstSyncRunning: The first check is already running.

delete.title: Remove mailbox?
delete.text: “{{name}}” will no longer be checked. Documents that have already been imported are kept.

dialog.description: You get the credentials from your email provider. The password is stored encrypted.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.securityNoneWarning: Without encryption, the username and password are transmitted in plain text.
dialog.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password
dialog.enabledHint: The mailbox is checked for new PDFs at the configured interval.

import.title: Schedule & import folder
import.intro: Defines how often the application looks for new PDF files – in the mailboxes and in the import folder.

interval.title: Check interval
interval.text: This is how often the application checks all mailboxes and the import folder for new PDFs.
interval.label: Every … minutes

folder.title: Import folder
folder.text: A directory on the server that is watched for new PDF files – for example the target of a network scanner. Subfolders are searched as well.
folder.pathHint: Absolute path. In the Docker container this is the mounted folder, usually {{path}}.
folder.keepHint: The files stay unchanged. The application remembers what it has already imported.
folder.moveHint: Imported files are moved to the “{{folder}}” subfolder – the import folder stays tidy.
folder.scanStarted: The import folder is being checked.

ai.title: AI
ai.navHint: LLM server, model and text recognition
ai.intro: The AI reads every new PDF, summarizes it, assigns a document type and tags, and extracts key facts such as amounts or deadlines.

server.title: LLM server
server.compatibilityModeHint: For servers that speak the Anthropic interface but support neither PDF input nor structured outputs: the document is sent to the model as text or, for scans, as page images. Leave this off for the Claude API.
server.testIncomplete: The settings are not complete yet

privacy.title: With {{provider}}, your documents leave this computer
privacy.text: For analysis, the content of every PDF is transmitted to the servers of {{provider}} on the internet and processed there – including invoices, contracts, medical letters and official correspondence.
privacy.recommendation: <emphasis>Recommendation:</emphasis> use a local AI. With <lmStudio>LM Studio</lmStudio> or an <compatible>OpenAI-compatible server</compatible> on your own network, all content stays with you.

ANTHROPIC.urlHint: Anthropic's Claude API. Only change this if you have your own gateway in front of it.
ANTHROPIC.modelHint: Claude Opus 5.5 is the recommended choice; Sonnet and Haiku are faster and cheaper.

OPENAI.urlHint: OpenAI's API. Only change this if you have your own gateway in front of it.
OPENAI.modelHint: The model ID as OpenAI names it. After you save the key, the available models appear here.

MOONSHOT.urlHint: The API of Moonshot AI (Kimi). For accounts on the Chinese platform: {{url}}
MOONSHOT.modelHint: The model ID as Moonshot names it. After you save the key, the available models appear here.

LM_STUDIO.urlHint: LM Studio's local server (start it in LM Studio under “Developer”). If AIDocuments runs in Docker: {{url}}
LM_STUDIO.modelHint: The ID of the model loaded in LM Studio. Scans need a model with image input, analysis needs one with tool use.

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE.urlHint: Address of a server that speaks the OpenAI interface – usually ending in /v1, e.g. {{url}}
OPENAI_COMPATIBLE.modelHint: The model ID as the server names it. After saving, the models it offers appear here.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.placeholderIfRequired: only if the server requires one
apiKey.hintRemoving: The stored key will be removed when you save.
apiKey.hintStored: A key is stored in encrypted form. Leave empty to keep it – <remove>remove key</remove>
apiKey.hintEnvironment: The key currently comes from the server configuration (environment variable or configuration file). A key entered here takes precedence.
apiKey.hintPreset: A key for this provider is preset in the server configuration. Leave empty to use it.
apiKey.hintDiscardedOnSwitch: The key stored so far belongs to {{previous}} and will be discarded when you switch.
apiKey.hintPresetOtherProvider: The preset key is only valid for {{previous}}. Please enter a separate one for {{provider}}.
apiKey.hintRequired: Stored in encrypted form and never shown again.
apiKey.hintLocal: Local servers usually do not need a key.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.effortHint: More thorough means more careful results, but slower and more expensive per document.
analysis.outputLanguageHint: The AI writes the title, summary and tags in this language.
analysis.ocrHint: The application has the AI transcribe scanned PDFs without a text layer – only then can they be found by full-text search. Each scan takes more time and costs more.

ai.unanalyzed_one: {{count, number}} document has not been analyzed by the AI yet.
ai.unanalyzed_other: {{count, number}} documents have not been analyzed by the AI yet.
ai.analysisStarted_one: {{count, number}} document is now being analyzed.
ai.analysisStarted_other: {{count, number}} documents are now being analyzed.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Each person signs in with their own account. Administrators manage the application, users work with the documents.

delete.title: Delete user?
delete.text: The account “{{name}}” will be deleted and signed out immediately. Documents are kept.

dialog.selfNotice: This is your own account. After saving you will have to sign in again.
dialog.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current password. Otherwise at least 8 characters.

roleHints.ADMIN: May do everything – including changing settings, managing users and deleting documents.
roleHints.USER: May view, search and upload documents and edit their details.

dialog.activeHint: Disabled accounts cannot sign in; active sessions end immediately.
